amc8-2019-q1.summary: Two students have $30$ dollars. Sandwiches cost $4.50$ dollars and drinks cost $1$ dollar. They first buy as many sandwiches as possible, then spend the remainder on drinks. How many items do they buy altogether?
amc8-2019-q1.summaryZh: 两名学生共有 $30$ 美元。三明治每个 $4.50$ 美元，饮料每杯 $1$ 美元。他们先尽可能多买三明治，再用余款买饮料。总共买到多少件商品？

methods.title: Maximise sandwiches, then use the remainder
methods.titleZh: 先使三明治数量最大，再使用余款
steps: Six sandwiches cost $6(4.50)=27$ dollars, while seven would cost $31.50>30$, so six is the maximum.
The remaining $30-27=3$ dollars buy three drinks. Hence the total number of items is $6+3=9$.
stepsZh: 六个三明治需 $6(4.50)=27$ 美元，而七个需 $31.50>30$ 美元，所以最多买六个。
余下 $30-27=3$ 美元可买三杯饮料，总件数为 $6+3=9$。

amc8-2019-q2.summary: Three congruent rectangles form a larger rectangle: two are stacked on the left and the third is rotated to fill the full height on the right. If every small rectangle has shorter side $5$ ft, find the area of the large rectangle.
amc8-2019-q2.summaryZh: 三个全等小长方形拼成一个大长方形：左侧两个上下叠放，右侧一个旋转后占满全高。若每个小长方形的短边为 $5$ 英尺，求大长方形面积。

methods.title: Use the tiling to determine both dimensions
methods.titleZh: 由拼图关系确定长和宽
steps: The two left rectangles are stacked along their short sides, so the common height is $2\cdot5=10$ ft. This is the long side of each small rectangle.
The large rectangle is therefore $10$ ft high and $10+5=15$ ft wide. Its area is $10\cdot15=150\text{ ft}^2$.
stepsZh: 左侧两个小长方形沿短边上下叠放，所以大图形高为 $2\cdot5=10$ 英尺，这也等于小长方形的长边。
大长方形尺寸为 $10$ 英尺乘 $(10+5)=15$ 英尺，面积为 $10\cdot15=150$ 平方英尺。

amc8-2019-q3.summary: Arrange $15/11$, $19/15$, and $17/13$ from least to greatest.

methods.title: Compare equal numerators after subtracting one
methods.titleZh: 减去一后比较同分子分数
steps: For positive fractions with the same numerator, a larger denominator gives a smaller value. Thus $4/15<4/13<4/11$, giving the stated order.
stepsZh: 正分数分子相同时，分母越大数值越小，因此 $4/15<4/13<4/11$，得到所述顺序。

amc8-2019-q4.summary: A rhombus has perimeter $52$ m and one diagonal of length $24$ m. Find its area.
amc8-2019-q4.summaryZh: 一个菱形的周长为 $52$ 米，其中一条对角线长 $24$ 米。求其面积。

methods.title: Recover the second diagonal
methods.titleZh: 求出另一条对角线
steps: Each side is $52/4=13$ m. The perpendicular diagonals bisect each other, so half of the known diagonal is $12$ m.
A quarter of the rhombus is a right triangle with hypotenuse $13$ and one leg $12$, so the other leg is $\sqrt{13^2-12^2}=5$. The second diagonal is $10$ m.
The area is half the product of the diagonals: $\tfrac12(24)(10)=120\text{ m}^2$.
stepsZh: 每条边长为 $52/4=13$ 米。菱形两条对角线互相垂直且平分，因此已知对角线的一半为 $12$ 米。
菱形四分之一是斜边 $13$、一条直角边 $12$ 的直角三角形，另一条直角边为 $\sqrt{13^2-12^2}=5$，故另一条对角线长 $10$ 米。
面积为两条对角线乘积的一半：$\tfrac12(24)(10)=120$ 平方米。

amc8-2019-q5.summary: A tortoise moves at a slow constant speed throughout a race. A hare first runs faster, stops for a nap, then runs again, but finishes after the tortoise. Choose the distance--time graph with: one straight constant-slope tortoise path reaching the finish first; and a hare path that is steep, then horizontal, then steep again, reaching the same final distance later.
amc8-2019-q5.summaryZh: 乌龟全程以缓慢的恒定速度前进。兔子先快速奔跑，停下睡觉，再继续奔跑，但比乌龟晚到终点。选择满足下列条件的路程—时间图：乌龟轨迹为直线且先到终点；兔子轨迹依次为陡升、水平、再陡升，并在更晚时刻到达同一终点距离。
amc8-2019-q5.answer: B. The graph with the tortoise finishing first and the hare's steep--flat--steep path finishing later
amc8-2019-q5.answerZh: B．乌龟先到终点、兔子“陡升—水平—陡升”且稍后到达的图

methods.title: Translate each part of the story into a graph feature
methods.titleZh: 把故事逐项翻译为图像特征
steps: Constant speed gives a straight line; faster running gives a steeper slope; and a nap gives a horizontal segment because distance stays fixed while time passes.

Both competitors cover the same race distance, so their endpoints have the same height. The tortoise arrives first, so its endpoint lies to the left of the hare's endpoint. Only graph B has all these features.
stepsZh: 匀速运动对应直线；速度较快对应更大的斜率；睡觉时距离不变而时间继续，所以对应水平线段。
两者跑同一赛程，终点纵坐标相同；乌龟先到，因此乌龟终点的横坐标更小。只有图 B 同时满足这些条件。

amc8-2019-q6.summary: A square contains a $9\times9$ array of equally spaced grid points, including boundary points. The centre point is $P$. A point $Q$ is chosen uniformly from the other $80$ points. Find the probability that line $PQ$ is a symmetry axis of the square.
amc8-2019-q6.summaryZh: 一个正方形内有 $9\times9$ 个等距格点（含边界点），中心点为 $P$。从其余 $80$ 个点中等可能地选一点 $Q$。求直线 $PQ$ 是正方形对称轴的概率。

methods.title: Count points on the four symmetry axes
methods.titleZh: 统计四条对称轴上的格点
steps: The square has four symmetry axes: two diagonals and the horizontal and vertical midlines. Each contains $9$ grid points, of which $8$ are different from $P$.
The axes meet only at $P$, which is excluded, so the favourable choices are $4\cdot8=32$. The probability is $32/80=2/5$.
stepsZh: 正方形有四条对称轴：两条对角线以及水平、竖直中线。每条轴上有 $9$ 个格点，其中 $8$ 个不是 $P$。
四条轴除 $P$ 外互不相交，而 $P$ 不可选，因此有利选择数为 $4\cdot8=32$，概率为 $32/80=2/5$。

amc8-2019-q7.summary: A student takes five tests, each worth at most $100$ points. Her first three scores are $76,94,87$. If her five-test average must be $81$, what is the lowest possible score on either remaining test?
amc8-2019-q7.summaryZh: 一名学生参加五次满分均为 $100$ 分的考试，前三次成绩为 $76,94,87$。若五次平均分必须为 $81$，后两次中较低的一次最少可以是多少分？

methods.title: Maximise the other remaining score
methods.titleZh: 把另一次剩余成绩取到最大
steps: The five scores must total $5\cdot81=405$. To minimise one remaining score, make the other as large as possible, namely $100$.
The first three plus $100$ total $76+94+87+100=357$, so the minimum fifth score is $405-357=48$.
stepsZh: 五次成绩总和必须为 $5\cdot81=405$。要使其中一个剩余成绩最小，就令另一个达到最高的 $100$ 分。

amc8-2019-q8.summary: From a bag of marbles, $20\%$ are given away. Then $10\%$ of the remainder are given away, followed by $25\%$ of the new remainder. What percentage of the original marbles remains?
amc8-2019-q8.summaryZh: 一袋弹珠先送出总数的 $20\%$，再送出余下弹珠的 $10\%$，最后送出新余数的 $25\%$。最终剩下原有弹珠的百分之几？

methods.title: Multiply the successive retention factors
methods.titleZh: 连乘每一步的保留比例
steps: The retained fractions are $0.80$, then $0.90$, then $0.75$.
Their product is $0.80\cdot0.90\cdot0.75=0.54$, so $54\%$ of the original bag remains.

amc8-2019-q9.summary: One cylindrical can has diameter $6$ cm and height $12$ cm; another has diameter $12$ cm and height $6$ cm. Find the ratio of the first can's volume to the second can's volume.
amc8-2019-q9.summaryZh: 第一个圆柱罐直径为 $6$ 厘米、高为 $12$ 厘米；第二个直径为 $12$ 厘米、高为 $6$ 厘米。求第一个与第二个圆柱罐的体积比。

methods.title: Compare $r^2h$
methods.titleZh: 比较 $r^2h$
steps: The radii are $3$ and $6$, so the volume ratio is $\pi(3^2)(12):\pi(6^2)(6)$.
Canceling common factors gives $108:216=1:2$.

amc8-2019-q10.summary: Soccer-practice attendance was recorded as Monday $20$, Tuesday $26$, Wednesday $16$, Thursday $22$, Friday $16$. Wednesday is corrected to $21$. Determine how the mean and median change.
amc8-2019-q10.summaryZh: 足球训练人数记录为：周一 $20$、周二 $26$、周三 $16$、周四 $22$、周五 $16$。现将周三更正为 $21$。判断平均数和中位数如何变化。
amc8-2019-q10.answer: B. The mean increases by $1$ and the median increases by $1$
amc8-2019-q10.answerZh: B．平均数增加 $1$，中位数也增加 $1$

methods.title: Update the total and reorder the data
methods.titleZh: 更新总和并重新排序
steps: The correction raises the total by $21-16=5$, so over five days the mean rises by $5/5=1$.
Originally the ordered list is $16,16,20,22,26$ with median $20$. Afterwards it is $16,20,21,22,26$ with median $21$, an increase of $1$.
stepsZh: 更正使总人数增加 $21-16=5$，共有五天，所以平均数增加 $5/5=1$。

amc8-2019-q11.summary: Among $93$ students, every student takes mathematics or a foreign language or both. Mathematics has $70$ students and foreign language has $54$. How many take mathematics only?
amc8-2019-q11.summaryZh: $93$ 名学生每人学习数学、外语或两者都学。数学课有 $70$ 人，外语课有 $54$ 人。只学习数学的有多少人？

methods.title: Apply inclusion--exclusion
methods.titleZh: 使用容斥原理
steps: The number taking both subjects is $70+54-93=31$.
Subtract these from all mathematics students: $70-31=39$ take mathematics only.
stepsZh: 同时学习两科的人数为 $70+54-93=31$。
从全部数学课学生中减去这 $31$ 人，得只学数学的有 $70-31=39$ 人。

amc8-2019-q12.summary: A cube's six faces are colored red, white, green, purple, yellow, and black. Three corner views show the triples (top, front, right) as (black, red, green), (black, white, red), and (red, purple, green). Which color is opposite yellow?
amc8-2019-q12.summaryZh: 一个正方体六个面分别涂成红、白、绿、紫、黄、黑。三个角度看到的（上、前、右）三面依次为（黑、红、绿）、（黑、白、红）、（红、紫、绿）。哪一种颜色与黄色相对？

methods.title: List the four neighbours of one face
methods.titleZh: 列出一个面的四个相邻面
steps: Faces appearing together in a corner view are adjacent. Red appears with black and green in the first view, with black and white in the second, and with purple and green in the third.
Thus red is adjacent to black, green, white, and purple—the four possible neighbouring faces. The only remaining color, yellow, must be opposite red.
stepsZh: 同一角度同时可见的面彼此相邻。第一幅中红色与黑、绿相邻；第二幅中红色与黑、白相邻；第三幅中红色与紫、绿相邻。
所以红色的四个相邻面恰为黑、绿、白、紫，剩下的黄色必与红色相对。

amc8-2019-q13.summary: Let $N$ be the least three-digit number that is not a palindrome but is the sum of three distinct two-digit palindromes. Find the sum of the digits of $N$.
amc8-2019-q13.summaryZh: 设 $N$ 是最小的三位非回文数，且 $N$ 可表示为三个互不相同的两位回文数之和。求 $N$ 的各位数字之和。

methods.title: Use multiples of eleven
methods.titleZh: 利用十一的倍数
steps: Every two-digit palindrome is $11k$, so their sum is a multiple of $11$. The smallest three-digit multiple of $11$ is $110$, and it is not a palindrome.
$110$ is attainable using three distinct two-digit palindromes: $110=11+22+77$. Hence $N=110$ and its digit sum is $1+1+0=2$.
stepsZh: 每个两位回文数都形如 $11k$，所以三个这样的数之和必为 $11$ 的倍数。最小的三位 $11$ 的倍数是 $110$，它不是回文数。
$110=11+22+77$，确实可由三个不同的两位回文数得到。因此 $N=110$，数字和为 $1+1+0=2$。

amc8-2019-q14.summary: Six coupons are redeemed one every $10$ days. None of the six redemption dates may be Sunday. If the first date must be a weekday from Monday through Friday, on which weekday can the first coupon be used?
amc8-2019-q14.summaryZh: 共有六张优惠券，每隔 $10$ 天使用一张，六次使用日期都不能是星期日。若第一次使用日在星期一至星期五之间，应从星期几开始？

methods.title: Reduce ten days modulo seven
methods.titleZh: 将十天按模七化简
steps: Each $10$-day jump advances the weekday by $10\equiv3\pmod7$. Starting Wednesday, the six dates are Wednesday, Saturday, Tuesday, Friday, Monday, and Thursday.
This list contains no Sunday. Checking the other weekday starts, each reaches Sunday among its first six dates, so Wednesday is the required start.
stepsZh: 每隔 $10$ 天，星期向后移动 $10\equiv3\pmod7$ 天。从星期三开始，六次依次为星期三、六、二、五、一、四。
其中没有星期日；逐一检查其他工作日起点，都会在前六次内遇到星期日，所以应从星期三开始。

amc8-2019-q15.summary: At a beach, $50$ people wear sunglasses and $35$ wear caps. Among cap wearers, the probability of also wearing sunglasses is $2/5$. Among sunglasses wearers, find the probability of also wearing a cap.
amc8-2019-q15.summaryZh: 海滩上有 $50$ 人戴太阳镜、$35$ 人戴帽子。在戴帽子的人中，随机选一人也戴太阳镜的概率为 $2/5$。在戴太阳镜的人中随机选一人，求其也戴帽子的概率。

methods.title: Count the intersection first
methods.titleZh: 先求两集合的交集人数
steps: The number wearing both items is $(2/5)\cdot35=14$.
Among the $50$ sunglasses wearers, the desired fraction is therefore $14/50=7/25$.
stepsZh: 同时戴帽子和太阳镜的人数为 $(2/5)\cdot35=14$。
在 $50$ 名戴太阳镜者中，所求比例为 $14/50=7/25$。

amc8-2019-q16.summary: A driver first travels $15$ miles at $30$ mph. How many additional miles must be driven at $55$ mph so that the average speed for the whole trip is $50$ mph?
amc8-2019-q16.summaryZh: 一名司机先以 $30$ 英里/小时行驶 $15$ 英里。此后以 $55$ 英里/小时还需行驶多少英里，才能使全程平均速度为 $50$ 英里/小时？

methods.title: Equate total time with distance divided by average speed
methods.titleZh: 用总路程除以平均速度表示总时间
steps: Let the second distance be $x$ miles. The two travel times are $15/30=1/2$ hour and $x/55$ hour.
The whole trip has distance $15+x$ and average speed $50$, so $\frac12+\frac{x}{55}=\frac{15+x}{50}$. Multiplying by $550$ gives $275+10x=165+11x$, hence $x=110$.
stepsZh: 设第二段路程为 $x$ 英里，两段用时分别为 $15/30=1/2$ 小时与 $x/55$ 小时。

methods.title: Split into two telescoping products
methods.titleZh: 拆成两个连乘消项式
steps: Factor each term as $\frac{k}{k+1}\cdot\frac{k+2}{k+1}$. Thus the product is $\left(\prod_{k=1}^{98}\frac{k}{k+1}\right)\left(\prod_{k=1}^{98}\frac{k+2}{k+1}\right)$.
The first product is $1/99$ and the second is $100/2=50$, so the value is $50/99$.
stepsZh: 把每项写为 $\frac{k}{k+1}\cdot\frac{k+2}{k+1}$，于是原式等于 $\left(\prod_{k=1}^{98}\frac{k}{k+1}\right)\left(\prod_{k=1}^{98}\frac{k+2}{k+1}\right)$。

methods.title: Cancel neighbouring factors directly
methods.titleZh: 直接配对相邻因子消项
steps: Write the factors in order: $\frac{1\cdot3}{2^2}\frac{2\cdot4}{3^2}\cdots\frac{98\cdot100}{99^2}$. Every interior integer cancels once from each numerator chain against the denominator chain.
Only $1/2$ at the left and $100/99$ at the right remain, giving $(1/2)(100/99)=50/99$.
stepsZh: 依次写成 $\frac{1\cdot3}{2^2}\frac{2\cdot4}{3^2}\cdots\frac{98\cdot100}{99^2}$，中间整数在两条分子链与分母链之间全部约去。

amc8-2019-q18.summary: Two fair dice each have faces numbered $1,2,3,5,7,8$. Find the probability that their sum is even.
amc8-2019-q18.summaryZh: 两枚公平骰子的六个面均标有 $1,2,3,5,7,8$。求两骰点数之和为偶数的概率。

methods.title: Match the parities
methods.titleZh: 按奇偶性分类
steps: Each die has two even faces and four odd faces, so $P(E)=1/3$ and $P(O)=2/3$.
An even sum occurs for two evens or two odds. Independence gives $(1/3)^2+(2/3)^2=1/9+4/9=5/9$.
stepsZh: 每枚骰子有两个偶数面、四个奇数面，因此掷出偶数与奇数的概率分别为 $1/3$ 与 $2/3$。

amc8-2019-q19.summary: Six soccer teams play every other team twice. A win gives $3$ points, a draw $1$, and a loss $0$. The top three teams finish with equal totals. Find the greatest possible total for each of those three teams.
amc8-2019-q19.summaryZh: 六支足球队两两比赛两次。胜得 $3$ 分、平得 $1$ 分、负得 $0$ 分。最终前三名积分相同。求这三队各自可能取得的最大积分。

methods.title: Bound points from lower teams and from one another
methods.titleZh: 分别估计对后三队和前三队内部所得积分
steps: Each top team plays six games against the bottom three teams and can earn at most $6\cdot3=18$ points there.
Among the top three there are three pairs, each playing twice, hence six games. At most $18$ points are awarded in these games, so equal totals give at most $18/3=6$ points per top team.
Thus each has at most $18+6=24$ points. This is attainable if all top teams beat all bottom teams and, within each top-team pair, each team wins once.
stepsZh: 每支前三名球队与后三队共赛六场，最多得到 $6\cdot3=18$ 分。
前三队内部有三对球队，每对赛两场，共六场，至多产生 $18$ 分；三队积分相同，因此每队在内部比赛至多分得 $18/3=6$ 分。
故每队至多 $18+6=24$ 分。让前三队全胜后三队，并让每对前三球队各赢一场，即可达到此上界。

amc8-2019-q20.summary: How many distinct real numbers $x$ satisfy $(x^2-5)^2=16$?
amc8-2019-q20.summaryZh: 方程 $(x^2-5)^2=16$ 有多少个不同的实数解？

methods.title: Take both square-root cases
methods.titleZh: 分别考虑平方根的正负两种情况
steps: Thus $x^2=9$ or $x^2=1$, giving $x=\pm3,\pm1$. These are four distinct real numbers.
stepsZh: 所以 $x^2=9$ 或 $x^2=1$，即 $x=\pm3,\pm1$，共有四个不同实数解。

amc8-2019-q21.summary: Find the area of the triangle enclosed by the three lines $y=5$, $y=1+x$, and $y=1-x$.
amc8-2019-q21.summaryZh: 求三条直线 $y=5$、$y=1+x$、$y=1-x$ 围成的三角形面积。

methods.title: Find the three intersections
methods.titleZh: 求三个交点
steps: The line $y=5$ meets $y=1+x$ at $(4,5)$ and $y=1-x$ at $(-4,5)$. The two sloping lines meet at $(0,1)$.
The horizontal base has length $8$, and the perpendicular height is $5-1=4$. Therefore the area is $\tfrac12\cdot8\cdot4=16$.
stepsZh: 水平底边长为 $8$，高为 $5-1=4$，故面积为 $\tfrac12\cdot8\cdot4=16$。

amc8-2019-q22.summary: A store raises a shirt's price by $p\%$ and then reduces the new price by the same $p\%$. The final price is $84\%$ of the original. Find $p$.
amc8-2019-q22.summaryZh: 商店先将衬衫价格提高 $p\%$，再将新价格降低同样的 $p\%$。最终价格为原价的 $84\%$。求 $p$。

methods.title: Multiply the two price factors
methods.titleZh: 连乘两次价格变化因子
steps: Let $r=p/100$. Relative to the original price, the two changes multiply the price by $(1+r)(1-r)=1-r^2$.
Set $1-r^2=0.84$. Then $r^2=0.16$ and the positive rate is $r=0.4$, so $p=40$.
stepsZh: 令 $r=p/100$。相对于原价，两次变化使价格乘以 $(1+r)(1-r)=1-r^2$。

amc8-2019-q23.summary: A basketball team scores $T$ points. Alexa scores $T/4$, Brittany scores $2T/7$, and Chelsea scores $15$. The other seven players each score at most $2$. Find the total scored by those seven players.
amc8-2019-q23.summaryZh: 某篮球队共得 $T$ 分。Alexa 得 $T/4$ 分，Brittany 得 $2T/7$ 分，Chelsea 得 $15$ 分；其余七人每人至多得 $2$ 分。求这七人的总得分。

methods.title: Use divisibility and the score bound
methods.titleZh: 结合整除性与得分上界
steps: Let the seven players score $y$ in total. Then $T/4+2T/7+15+y=T$, so $15+y=13T/28$.

Because the two fractional scores are integers, $T$ is a multiple of $28$. Also $0\le y\le14$. The case $T=28$ gives $y=-2$, impossible; $T=56$ gives $15+y=26$, hence $y=11$, which satisfies the bound. Larger multiples make $y>14$.
stepsZh: 两项分数得分均为整数，所以 $T$ 是 $28$ 的倍数；又有 $0\le y\le14$。$T=28$ 时 $y=-2$ 不合题意；$T=56$ 时 $15+y=26$，得 $y=11$，满足上界；更大的倍数会使 $y>14$。

amc8-2019-q24.summary: In triangle $ABC$, point $D$ lies on $AC$ with $AD:DC=1:2$. Point $E$ is the midpoint of $BD$, and line $AE$ meets $BC$ at $F$. If $[ABC]=360$, find $[EBF]$.
amc8-2019-q24.summaryZh: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，点 $D$ 在 $AC$ 上且 $AD:DC=1:2$。点 $E$ 是 $BD$ 的中点，直线 $AE$ 与 $BC$ 交于 $F$。若 $[ABC]=360$，求 $[EBF]$。

methods.title: Use mass points and area ratios
methods.titleZh: 用质量点与面积比
steps: Since $AD:DC=1:2$, assign masses $m_A=2$ and $m_C=1$. Because $E$ is the midpoint of $BD$, we need $m_B=m_D=m_A+m_C=3$.
On $BC$, mass points gives $BF:FC=m_C:m_B=1:3$, so $[ABF]=\frac14[ABC]=90$.
Triangles $ABE$ and $ABD$ share the altitude from $A$, and $BE=ED$, so $[ABE]=\frac12[ABD]$. Also $[ABD]=\frac13[ABC]=120$, hence $[ABE]=60$. Therefore $[EBF]=[ABF]-[ABE]=90-60=30$.
stepsZh: 由 $AD:DC=1:2$，可取质量 $m_A=2,m_C=1$。又因 $E$ 是 $BD$ 中点，需要 $m_B=m_D=m_A+m_C=3$。
在 $BC$ 上由质量点法得 $BF:FC=m_C:m_B=1:3$，所以 $[ABF]=\frac14[ABC]=90$。
$\triangle ABE$ 与 $\triangle ABD$ 从 $A$ 到 $BD$ 的高相同，且 $BE=ED$，故 $[ABE]=\frac12[ABD]$。又 $[ABD]=\frac13[ABC]=120$，所以 $[ABE]=60$，最终 $[EBF]=90-60=30$。

methods.title: Verify with coordinates
methods.titleZh: 用坐标法核验
steps: Choose $A=(0,3)$, $C=(0,0)$, and $B=(b,0)$. Then $D=(0,2)$ and the midpoint $E=(b/2,1)$.
Line $AE$ has parametrisation $(tb/2,3-2t)$. Setting $y=0$ gives $t=3/2$, so $F=(3b/4,0)$. Thus $BF=b/4$.
Using base $BF$ and height $1$ from $E$, $[EBF]=\frac12(b/4)(1)=b/8$. Meanwhile $[ABC]=\frac12(3)b=3b/2=360$, so $b=240$ and $[EBF]=30$.
stepsZh: 以 $BF$ 为底，点 $E$ 到底边的高为 $1$，故 $[EBF]=\frac12(b/4)=b/8$。而 $[ABC]=\frac12(3)b=3b/2=360$，得 $b=240$，所以 $[EBF]=30$。

amc8-2019-q25.summary: Distribute $24$ identical apples among Alice, Becky, and Chris so that each person receives at least $2$. How many distributions are possible?
amc8-2019-q25.summaryZh: 把 $24$ 个相同的苹果分给 Alice、Becky 和 Chris，要求每人至少得到 $2$ 个。共有多少种分法？

methods.title: Give the minimum first, then use stars and bars
methods.titleZh: 先满足下限，再用隔板法
steps: Give each person $2$ apples first, leaving $24-3\cdot2=18$ apples.
If $a,b,c\ge0$ are the additional amounts, then $a+b+c=18$. Stars and bars gives $\binom{18+3-1}{3-1}=\binom{20}{2}=190$ distributions.
stepsZh: 先给每人 $2$ 个苹果，余下 $24-3\cdot2=18$ 个。
设三人额外得到的数量为 $a,b,c\ge0$，则 $a+b+c=18$。由隔板法，分法数为 $\binom{18+3-1}{3-1}=\binom{20}{2}=190$。
